text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opposition in intro and conclusion","quality":"argument focus","description":"It maintains a consistent position against driverless cars and returns to that claim at the end."},{"evidence":"three organized body paragraphs on accidents, preference, and cost","quality":"organization","description":"It develops separate reasons in a clear sequence that makes the essay easier to follow."},{"evidence":"\"if there was an accident... who would pay\"","quality":"elaboration","description":"It expands points with multiple follow-up questions and examples instead of stopping at a single claim."},{"evidence":"\"as said in the article\" and mentions of insurance and laws","quality":"source use","description":"It connects its reasons to details from the source article and shows the issues are grounded in the text."},{"evidence":"\"In conclusion...\" with a restated claim and reasons","quality":"conclusion","description":"It ends by summarizing the argument in a way that reinforces the main position."}]}
